items.mainDefect: The computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` in the minimum schema evaluate to the same literal property name, so z.object strips all keys except access_token and expiry fields are lost in sync mode.

secondary.defect: parseRefreshTokenResponse always fills a missing refresh_token with the placeholder string "refresh_token", overwriting the real stored refresh token (e.g. Office365, Zoom).

items.mainDefect: Both computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` evaluate to the same string, so the schema strips expiry fields and the real refresh_token from the parsed response.

secondary.defect: Line 26 always replaces the refresh token with the placeholder "refresh_token".

items.mainDefect: Salesforce getClient does an unconditional refresh-token request and DB update every time the service is constructed.

secondary.defect: The response is checked with `response.statusText !== "OK"`, which is empty under HTTP/2/undici, so valid responses are rejected and all Salesforce operations fail.
The jsforce Connection is still built with the old access_token, so the refreshed token is never used.
In sync mode the refresh_token is overwritten by the parseRefreshTokenResponse placeholder.

items.mainDefect: The app-credential webhook secret is compared with non-constant-time `!==`, leaking timing information about the secret.

secondary.defect: The request body is parsed with `.parse` (and decryption/JSON.parse is unguarded), so malformed input causes unhandled 500s instead of 400 responses.
